releases.summary:
We just had a miscarriage 😭 My girlfriend started bleeding and we immediately went to the doctor. He explained that the baby's heart didn't fully develop and that her body had already begun the expulsion process.
The doctor examined the baby and, given its size, it's unlikely it will go out on its own, so they need to perform a D&C, which costs $350.
I'm offering my digital book to anyone who wants to help me through this; the cost is $15.
